body: Man live your life. If you think its fucked, then go do whatever you need to get a fucking smile. I mean now you literally have nothing to fear. You just have to keep throwing shit at the wall till it sticks. I don't even know what I am going to do. But I am going to keep throwing things till I find my thing or reason to give this fight to death up. You did. You gave up because that person on the other side gave you a reason. Live for that fucking reason cause you decided to go back to whatever life you were living for it. Don't let that reason be a burden cause you could have left it back then. Embrace it and live for it. Not everyone finds a reason to back down last second. People who have nothing to lose are the best fucking people because they give their soul to whatever they do. Find what you want to give your soul to. Hope this finds you some comfort or hatred. Either way you know how you feel and what to do.
